## Luna ting

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
```

Do the genes have repeats

```{r}

batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  summarise(n = n())
  
```

```{r}
batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  nest() 
```

```{r}
batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  nest() |> 
  filter(Gene_symbol == "RERE") |> 
  unnest()
```

```{r}
batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  nest() |> 
  filter(Gene_symbol == "RERE") |> 
  mutate(data = map(.x = data,
                    .f = ~pivot_longer(.x,
                      cols = starts_with("SAMPLE"),
                      names_to = "Sample_ID",
                      values_to = "Sample_expression"
                    ))) |> 
  unnest()
```

```{r}
batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  nest() |> 
  filter(Gene_symbol == "RERE") |> 
  mutate(data = map(.x = data,
                    .f = ~pivot_longer(.x,
                      cols = starts_with("SAMPLE"),
                      names_to = "Sample_ID",
                      values_to = "Sample_expression"
                    ))) |> 
  mutate(data = map(.x = data,
                    .f = ~summarize(.x, 
                                    Avr_Ex = mean(Sample_expression),
                                    .by = Sample_ID)
                    )) |> 
  unnest()
```

```{r}
avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined <- batchCN_array_combined |> 
  group_by(Gene_symbol) |> 
  nest() |> 
  mutate(data = map(.x = data,
                    .f = ~pivot_longer(.x,
                      cols = starts_with("SAMPLE"),
                      names_to = "Sample_ID",
                      values_to = "Sample_expression"
                    ))) |> 
  mutate(data = map(.x = data,
                    .f = ~summarize(.x, 
                                    Avr_Ex = mean(Sample_expression),
                                    .by = Sample_ID)
                    )) |> 
  unnest(cols = c(data))
```

```{r}
tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined <- avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined |> 
  ungroup(Gene_symbol) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gene_symbol,
              values_from = Avr_Ex) 
```

```{r}
tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined
```

```{r}
tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined |> 
  filter(str_ends(Sample_ID, "Replicate"))
```

```{r}
tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined |> 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, " Replicate")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample_ID,
               names_to = "Genes",
               values_to = "Values") |> 
  group_by(Sample_ID, Genes) |> 
  summarize(Values = mean(Values)) 
```

```{r}
rep_removed_tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined <- tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined |> 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, " Replicate")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample_ID,
               names_to = "Genes",
               values_to = "Values") |> 
  group_by(Sample_ID, Genes) |> 
  summarize(Values = mean(Values)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Genes,
              values_from = Values)
```

```{r}
rep_removed_tidy_avr_probe_batchCN_array_combined
```
